title: IRGC WARNS 'CHILD-KILLING' Trump:
text:
IRGC WARNS 'CHILD-KILLING' Trump:"

"'Hormuz remains CLOSED' — ANY vessel attempting to transit must use 'IRGC-designated route'"

"THREATENS: 'Not a SINGLE drop of oil will be exported' if Trump follows through threats"

"Says US threats will 'only lead to a wider regional war..."

"AND PERHAPS BEYOND!'
